tools.name: vulkill_watchtower_register_target
tools.description: Get a DNS ownership challenge for an exact public HTTPS host, after the owner confirms authority. Show verification.name and verification.value to the owner and save id for vulkill_watchtower_verify_target. Retrying the same origin reuses its record. Registration leaves DNS and billing untouched.

tools.name: vulkill_watchtower_verify_target
tools.description: Check the public DNS TXT record for a site registered to the signed-in account. Pass its registration UUID as id. A matching record marks the target verified. tools.name: vulkill_watchtower_enable

tools.name: vulkill_watchtower_manage
tools.description:
Add a decoy, subscribe to summaries, or test delivery. Each action needs owner approval (consent=true) and Watchtower write access (watch:manage).
• createCanary adds a link or token that alerts on use. Take target from monitors in the Watchtower overview, choose kind, and supply a fresh UUID as id.

tools.name: vulkill_watchtower_control
tools.description:
Change or withdraw existing protections with owner approval (consent=true) and Watchtower write access (watch:manage). For a new canary or a delivery test, use vulkill_watchtower_manage.
